description: This is a PHP source file implementing a client to interact with a testing management API, specifically for reporting test case results via XML-RPC. It defines a function 'reportResult' that constructs and sends a data payload to the server, and includes sample usage code. It references external utility files 'util.php' and 'sample.inc.php', and uses classes like 'IXR_Client' and 'dBug'.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: An external class used for making XML-RPC calls to the server.

classes.name: dBug
classes.description: A debugging class used to output variables and responses in a readable format.

methods.name: reportResult
methods.description: Constructs and sends a test case result report to the XML-RPC server, supporting various identifiers and including debug output.
